name: Docker Manager
description: Manage containers, inspect Docker resources, and view metrics and logs on this pane's server.

required.reason: Inspect and manage Docker on this pane's server. Commands run with your SSH account's authority; Docker access may grant root-equivalent authority.
Confirm container changes and shell commands before execution.

optional.reason: Open an interactive container shell in a Zync-owned terminal after your approval. Docker access can grant root-equivalent server authority.
